claim_rule: Innovation is presented as a reviewable design combination, not as a claim of first use, exclusivity, or proven effect.
hero_claim_zh: AI系统停运时，基本公共服务仍可用
hero_claim_en: AI SYSTEMS STOP · BASIC SERVICES STAY OPEN

records.title_zh: 同一首层公共开放空间的平时与停运双状态剖面
records.design_increment: The same section shows ordinary public access, staffed service, research/equipment operations, and the closure boundary in operating and stopped states.
records.peer_collision: AI-off continuity, human fallback, and stoppable validation are common upstream themes.
records.distinctive_combination: A compact two-state architectural section is repeated as the same spatial checklist across all thirteen scenario records.
records.falsifier: The claim fails if stopping research/equipment operations also closes ordinary public passage or staffed basic service.

records.title_zh: 十三项服务共用一套空间核对方法
records.design_increment: Each scenario records separate public, staffed-service, and operations interfaces plus access, queue, logistics, egress, and closure references.
records.peer_collision: Structured scenario cards and human takeover are common upstream practices.
records.distinctive_combination: The spatial references are linked both ways to the public-space and constraint layers and tested against one stopped-state rule.
records.falsifier: The claim fails if any scenario lacks the eight referenced spatial and operating conditions or if the links cannot be traced both ways.

records.title_zh: 三处重点区采用不同的专业回应
records.design_increment: Zhongzhiyuan tests controlled research and equipment operations, AI Origin organizes technology transfer and community service, and Dazhongsi uses verified public anchor relationships while withholding the disputed key-area polygon.
records.peer_collision: Three differentiated key-area roles are common to the competition brief.
records.distinctive_combination: One visual system carries two site-based concept modules and one explicitly non-georeferenced, non-boundary and non-quantitative four-quadrant design framework without inventing a replacement boundary.
records.falsifier: The claim fails if the three responses become interchangeable or if public context is presented as an official boundary or engineering base.
